prompt:
Locked-off camera. The man in rimless glasses, short beard, navy quilted gilet over a grey jumper sits centre frame facing the camera, right hand raised; a blurred tweed shoulder and grey head in the right foreground. He says "Back home we vote on each thing. We had a vote on cow horns." evenly, as plain fact, his hand turning palm up on "each thing"; on "cow horns" a tiny shrug and the faintest lift of the eyebrows, no smile. Then he lowers his hand and listens. Only his mouth moves for words; the foreground listener stays still. Same room, same warm light, only the people already here, the picture clean. Understated, believable; photographic.
Thanks.
